signals.name: Ben Thompson
signals.latest_title: Muse Spark Open, Meta + Apple, Thin and Thick
signals.summary: Meta has released a new open source model, and Apple is partnering with it so the model can run locally. Earlier in the week he asked whether you trust Apple, and argued the real question is whether Siri AI will justify deeper investment in Apple's ecosystem.
signals.connection: This fits the pace of lab releases and the push toward on-device AI. It adds an open-model counterweight to reports that Anthropic is readying a new model, and to OpenAI's $30B fundraising and revenue reset.

signals.name: Packy McCormick
signals.summary: A roundup of optimistic tech and science items, including a "flying" roadster, robots, and Arrowhead cutting tau.
signals.connection: The robots item loosely connects to Nvidia's physical-AI pact with Germany. Otherwise it offers an upbeat counterpoint to the day's market and rate worries.

signals.name: Lenny Rachitsky
signals.latest_title: Inside the black box of AI: How AI models actually think | Emmanuel Ameisen (Anthropic)
signals.summary: A 72-minute conversation with Anthropic's Emmanuel Ameisen on what interpretability research shows about model planning, consciousness, and AI safety. He also ran an episode on Brooke Lacey using Claude Code to turn raw phone video into captioned TikToks, and a How I AI episode on Meta Muse Wonder.
signals.connection: It ties into the report that Anthropic is readying a new model, and into the safety and governance debate. The Lacey episode is a labor and workforce example of AI-assisted creative work.
